messages.text:
"Bana 16-bit tarzında, üstten görünümlü (top-down) bir pixel art RPG oyunu yap. Oyun tarayıcıda ve mobilde oynanabilir olsun.

HİKAYE
- Oyunun adı: [Oyun adı]
- Oyuncu, köyü karanlık bir lanetten kurtarmaya çalışan genç bir kahramanı oynar.
- Ana hedef: 4 zindanı bitirip her birinden bir kristal toplamak, sonra final boss'u yenmek.
- Hikaye NPC diyaloglarıyla ve kısa ara sahnelerle anlatılsın.

GÖRSEL STİL
- 16x16 piksel karo (tile) tabanlı harita, canlı ve sıcak renk paleti
- Karakterler için 4 yönlü yürüme animasyonu (yukarı, aşağı, sol, sağ)
- Saldırı, hasar alma ve ölüm animasyonları
- Gün/gece döngüsü ve basit parçacık efektleri (yaprak, toz, büyü kıvılcımı)

OYUN MEKANİKLERİ
- Hareket: WASD/ok tuşları (masaüstü), sanal joystick + butonlar (mobil)
- Savaş: gerçek zamanlı aksiyon; kılıç saldırısı, dodge roll ve kalkan
- Statlar: HP, mana, saldırı, savunma, hız
- Seviye sistemi: düşman yenince XP, level atlayınca stat artışı ve yetenek ağacından 1 puan
- Yetenekler: ateş topu, iyileştirme, hızlanma (mana harcar)
- Envanter: silah, zırh, iksir, anahtar eşyalar; ekipman değiştirme
- Kaydetme sistemi: otomatik kayıt + manuel kayıt noktaları

DÜNYA
- Ana köy (dükkan, demirci, han, NPC'ler)
- Açık dünya: orman, çöl, buzul, volkanik bölge
- 4 zindan; her birinde bulmaca (basınç plakası, anahtar-kapı, itilebilir bloklar), tuzaklar, ara boss ve gizli odalar
- Harita üzerinde minimap ve hızlı seyahat noktaları

DÜŞMANLAR VE BOSSLAR
- Her bölge için 3-4 farklı düşman türü, her birinin kendine özgü saldırı paterni olsun
- Her zindanda benzersiz bir boss (2-3 fazlı savaş)
- Final boss: 3 fazlı, arena değiştiren epik savaş

GÖREVLER VE EKONOMİ
- Ana görev hattı + en az 8 yan görev
- Altın toplama, dükkândan alışveriş, eşya geliştirme (demirci)
- Loot sistemi: düşmanlardan rastgele eşya düşmesi, nadirlik seviyeleri (yaygın, nadir, efsanevi)

SES VE MÜZİK
- Her bölge için chiptune tarzı arka plan müziği
- Savaş, menü ve boss müzikleri ayrı olsun
- Adım, saldırı, eşya toplama ve arayüz ses efektleri

ARAYÜZ
- Üstte HP/mana barları, köşede minimap
- Retro pixel fontlu diyalog kutuları
- Ana menü, duraklatma menüsü, ayarlar (ses, kontroller)
- Oyun sonu ve ölüm ekranı

TEKNİK İSTEKLER
- Temiz, modüler kod yapısı
- 60 FPS performans
- Kolay genişletilebilir: yeni düşman, eşya ve harita eklemek basit olsun

Önce oyunun çekirdeğini (hareket, savaş, köy ve ilk zindan) çalışır halde ver, sonra adım adım diğer bölümleri ekleyelim.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- “Bana 16-bit tarzında, üstten görünümlü (top-down) bir pixel art RPG oyunu yap.”
- Build a complete, playable browser/mobile game, beginning with working movement, combat, village, and first dungeon.

## Requirements
- Turkish-language game, “Kül ve Kristal”; hero saves a village from a curse.
- Pixel-art top-down style, 16×16 tiles, warm palette, animations, day/night, particles.
- Desktop and mobile controls; real-time combat, abilities, stats, leveling, inventory, saving.
- Village, open regions, dungeons, puzzles, bosses, quests, economy, audio, HUD, menus.
- Modular, extensible code and 60 FPS; deliver the playable core first, then expand.

## Decisions
- Assumed the game title would be “Kül ve Kristal” and used a single-file HTML Canvas implementation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a Turkish game interface and started implementing canvas-rendered village/dungeon gameplay in `index.html`.

### Active
- Finish the JavaScript game implementation and make the page runnable.
- Test gameplay, controls, responsive layout, saving, and dungeon progression; fix issues found.

### Blocked
- `index.html` currently ends mid-function at `collides()`; the script and HTML are incomplete, so the game cannot run yet.

## Next Move
1. Continue `index.html` after `collides()`; complete rendering, update loop, input handlers, menu wiring, and closing script/HTML tags.
2. Run a JavaScript syntax check and launch the game in a browser to identify runtime errors.
3. Verify keyboard and touch movement, NPC interactions, combat, saving/loading, and the first dungeon flow.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: the only game file; currently incomplete and needs continuation.

## Important Context
- A prior syntax-check attempt failed because the expected `<script>` tag was not found in the earlier file version; the latest `index.html` rewrite does contain `<script>` but is unfinished.
- Changes are uncommitted; no browser verification or screenshot has been completed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- “Bana 16-bit tarzında, üstten görünümlü (top-down) bir pixel art RPG oyunu yap.”
- Create a playable Turkish browser/mobile RPG, “Kül ve Kristal,” with movement, combat, a village, and a first dungeon.

## Requirements
- Turkish-language game with top-down pixel-art style, combat, abilities, stats, leveling, inventory, saving, quests, and responsive desktop/mobile controls.
- Deliver a playable core first, then expand.

## Decisions
- Implement the game in a single HTML Canvas file, `index.html`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the core game, UI, village and dungeon content, dialogue, combat, inventory, saving, and touch controls in `index.html`.
- Added save/restore for player stats, dungeon block and puzzle state, and chest/boss progression.
- Guarded gameplay actions while the game is paused, in dialogue, or in the inventory; corrected the pause message to avoid promising autosave.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and passed the initial Chromium smoke test.
- Regression-tested chest loot persistence/no duplication and boss defeat/crystal progression successfully.

### Active
- Verify the dungeon puzzle/stone-block interaction with `/tmp/opencode/game-puzzle-test.cjs`; the test was just created and has not been run.
- Continue testing village movement and interactions, combat, inventory, mobile controls, and save/load behavior.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `node /tmp/opencode/game-puzzle-test.cjs` and fix any puzzle progression issues.
2. Run the syntax check, initial smoke test, and regression test after any further changes.
3. Check `git status` and `git diff --check`; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete single-file game implementation; changes are uncommitted.
- `/tmp/opencode/game-puzzle-test.cjs`: newly created, unrun dungeon puzzle interaction test.
- `/tmp/opencode/game-regression-test.cjs`: headless regression test for chest persistence and boss progression.
- `/tmp/opencode/game-test.cjs`: headless smoke test for menu, dialogue, saving, and mobile action buttons.

## Important Context
- The regression test passed: chest rewards persisted without duplication, and boss progression saved `bossDown: true`, `quest: 2`, `crystals: 1`.
- The puzzle test is intended to push the stone block onto the plate and verify `doorOpen`; adjust its simulated movement if necessary.

**“Kül ve Kristal” oynanabilir durumda.** Köy, zindan, savaş, envanter, görevler, kayıt sistemi ve mobil kontroller `index.html` içinde yer alıyor.

Doğrulamalar başarılı: bulmaca kapısı açılıyor, sandık ödülü tekrar verilmiyor, boss ilerlemesi kaydediliyor; başlangıç, diyalog ve mobil kontroller testleri de geçti. JavaScript sözdizimi ve `git diff --check` temiz. Kod değişiklikleri henüz commit edilmedi.
